pages.title: Sniffers Sniff Delights
pages.text: Sniffers dig up tomato seeds, cabbage seeds, rice or onions in about 9 of 10 digs. Torchflower seeds and pitcher pods are rare now.

Those four crops are also sniffer food, so you can lure and breed sniffers with them.\
\
Sniffer eggs are vanilla: brush Suspicious Sand in Warm Ocean Ruins. Needs [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().

pages.title: Delight Add-ons
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() All use the [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]() pot, board and skillet.
- Bring ingredients, a heat source and the right container.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Look recipes up in [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#](): hover, press **R**.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Delightful Creators** is the Create bridge.

A family of small mods adds foods that all use the Farmer's Delight pot, board and skillet. The rules are the same everywhere: bring ingredients, a heat source and the right container.\
\
Look recipes up in JEI (hover, press **R**). Meals and crops are listed below.

pages.title: Extended
pages.text: Farmer's Delight: Extended adds dishes made only from existing Minecraft, Create and Farmer's Delight items. No new crops or mobs. Cheese, burgers, breakfast plates, ice cream.

pages.title: Fruits Delight
pages.text: Fruit trees and bushes (pear, kiwi, mango, persimmon, lychee, fig and more) with jams, pies, jellos, popsicles and drinks. Right-click leaves that show ripe fruit to pick it; the leaves grow new fruit later.

pages.title: Fungi Delight
pages.text: Mushroom cooking: morel, inky cap and truffle crops and dishes such as truffle pasta and morel soup. Morel cows also exist.

pages.title: My Nether's Delight
pages.text: Hoglin, ghast and Nether-plant dishes, plus Nether-flavoured cabinets and decor. Meant for cooking in the Nether. Bastion chests hold some of its extras, like strider eggs.

pages.title: Ocean's Delight
pages.text:
Food from sea creatures: fugu, guardian parts, tentacles and more.\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** cook it carefully, as fugu is poisonous raw.

**Berries and Cherries Delight** adds grapes, strawberries, cherries, jams and pies. Pit cherries by crafting them with any knife. Its own Iron Knife is merged into the Farmer's Delight one, and old ones turn into it.

**Aquaculture Delight** lets Aquaculture fish work in Farmer's Delight recipes.\
\
**Sniffers Sniff Delights** makes Sniffers dig up tomato, cabbage, rice and onion seeds far more often.

**Delightful Creators** is the Create bridge: soups as fluids, [#](2E5AAC)[sequenced assembly](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]() meals and a Mechanical Cutter. See [#](2E5AAC)[Kitchen Automation](entry://food/kitchen_automation)[#]().\
\
**Brewin' and Chewin'** adds kegs and fermented drinks: [#](2E5AAC)[Brewing](entry://food/brewing)[#]().\
\
Base mechanics: [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().
